presetBalancedDesc: Everything left to the engine, plus the live-stream demuxer and cache tuning. The safest choice on most devices and networks, and the baseline every other preset builds on.

presetLowEndDesc: Software decoding capped at 2 threads, lowres downsampling, skipped loop filters and a smaller buffer. Hands the CPU back to the picture; for iGPUs and old machines.
presetStableNetworkDesc: Bigger demuxer buffers and read-ahead, forced seekability and reconnect backoff. Trades memory for fewer stalls on cross-network or edge-signal streams.
presetLowLatencyDesc: Minimum buffering with frame dropping on both decoder and render side, trading jitter tolerance for delay. For sports, duets and anything time-critical.

playerGuideIntro: The kernel options in this guide apply to the mpv engine; start with a preset and tune advanced options only when the picture still misbehaves.
playerGuideManualHint: Start from the symptom table; look up any setting in the glossary chapter.
playerGuideEntryHardwareSwitchBody: Let the GPU decode video instead of the CPU. Lower usage and heat when on; software decoding is the most compatible fallback and can be faster on old devices.
playerGuideEntryHwdecBody: Which hardware decode path to use. auto tries everything (may glitch on some SoCs); auto-safe only whitelisted paths (recommended); -copy variants decode back into memory, needed by some filters and screenshots.
playerGuideEntryVoBody: Where mpv draws the picture. libmpv renders into the Flutter texture (embedded, default); gpu/gpu-next/direct3d open a standalone mpv window (outside the app); null renders nothing.
playerGuideEntryAoBody: Which system channel carries the sound. Windows: wasapi; Android: audiotrack/aaudio/opensles; null mutes.
playerGuideEntryPresetDefaultBody: Clears custom output and decoder picks and leaves the choice to mpv. The first choice on most devices.
playerGuideEntryPresetAndroidCompatBody: mediacodec_embed surface + forced mediacodec decode, for glitch/green-screen/AV-desync devices. Android only.
playerGuideEntryPresetRtxSrBody: d3d11va decode plus the RTX Video Super Resolution filter for low-res sources; locks the decoder to d3d11va. Windows only.
playerGuideEntryPresetLowEndBody: Software decode with capped threads, lowres and a small buffer. For weak CPUs and iGPUs.
playerGuideEntryPresetWeakNetworkBody: Bigger buffers and reconnect backoff. Trades memory for fewer stalls.
playerGuideEntryPresetLowLatencyBody: Minimum buffering + frame dropping. Lowest delay, more hiccups.
playerGuideEntryVideoSyncBody: How audio and video clocks align. audio is the mpv default; display-resample is smoothest but GPU heavy and pairs with interpolation; vdrop/drop variants drop frames on drift. Desktop only.
playerGuideEntryInterpolationBody: Motion-interpolated rendering. Noticeably smoother pans; requires display-resample sync and real GPU headroom. Desktop only.
playerGuideEntryScaleBody: Upscaling kernel. lanczos is the balanced pick; ewa_lanczossharp the sharpest; ewa_lanczos4sharpest is designed for interpolation; bilinear/nearest are fastest but soft or blocky. Mobile only offers lanczos and bilinear.
playerGuideEntryDeinterlaceBody: Deinterlacing. Modern streams are progressive — leave on auto; only legacy TV/capture sources need yes.
playerGuideEntryRtxSuperResolutionBody: Settings → Player kernel → Super resolution: efficiency or quality. Windows desktop GPUs only; upscales low-res sources on high-DPI screens.
playerGuideEntryDanmakuLoadBody: In Settings → Danmaku style, lower the font size, speed or opacity, or hide the flying layer, to cut load on weak devices.
playerGuideEntryHwdecCodecsBody: Which codecs hardware-decode. Defaults to all; if a codec glitches, narrow the range to one that excludes it (software fallback).
playerGuideEntryAudioExclusiveBody: Windows only. Claims the WASAPI device exclusively — possibly cleaner output, but other apps go silent.
playerGuideEntryAoAdviceBody: When unsure use auto. On stutter: win32 (Windows) or opensles (Android); compare channels for Bluetooth latency.
playerGuideEntrySymGlitchTitle: Glitchy picture / green screen / AV desync
playerGuideEntrySymGlitchBody: Android: switch to the compat preset. Elsewhere: turn hardware decoding off, or set the decoder to auto-safe under Custom drivers and hardware acceleration.
playerGuideEntrySymBlurryTitle: Low-res sources look soft on a sharp screen
playerGuideEntrySymBlurryBody: Windows + NVIDIA: use the RTX VSR preset. Other GPUs: switch the scale kernel to ewa_lanczossharp, or enable Anime4K super resolution (Windows only).
playerGuideEntrySymFanBody: Use the low-end preset; if that fails, turn hardware decoding off (old devices can software-decode faster).
playerGuideEntrySymBufferingBody: Use the stable-network preset; also check the player proxy — a proxy is a common stall source.
playerGuideEntrySymLatencyBody: Use the low-latency preset and shrink buffering properties.
playerGuideEntrySymNoVideoBody: Check the video output driver: null renders nothing. Reset it to auto, or restore the player kernel defaults.

chatGiftValueInYuanDesc: Gold seeds, diamonds and Douyin coins are written in yuan at the platform's fixed rate; overseas currencies stay as they are.
superChatIncludesMembershipDesc: Bilibili guards, YouTube memberships and Twitch, CHZZK and other subscriptions also get a card among the Super Chats; the chat list keeps its one line.
danmakuShowGiftsDesc: Valuable gifts fly over the picture, precious ones stay at the top for 4 s; a combo flies at its start and with its total, at most 3 a second.
floatWindowSizeDesc: The in-app floating window’s base size; a resize is remembered separately for landscape and portrait.
backgroundPauseDanmaku: Pause the danmaku connection in background
backgroundPauseDanmakuDesc: Disconnect the platform danmaku while in the background and reconnect on return; the chat log stays.
douyuForceRenew: Renew the Douyu login every 5 minutes
douyuForceRenewDesc: Refresh the Douyu cookie periodically after signing in so long sessions keep their login.
tvFocusZoomDesc: Focused cards, menu entries and player controls grow a little; turn it off on a slow box to keep only the outline.
tvMenuExpandedDesc: Keep the sidebar labels visible; off, it is an icon rail that opens when focused.
